observation_unit: verb lexeme paired with the V;IND;PST;3;SG;POS;DECL paradigm cell
annotation_process: verb paradigms were semi-automatically generated and partially verified by a native speaker; unverified noun and adjective material is excluded
sampling_and_dependence: the population is a census of 588 distinct qualifying lemmas in the pinned resource; the 120-row table is a seeded simple random sample without replacement from that finite population
original_use: morphological reinflection from a lemma and UniMorph feature bundle to an inflected form, with cross-language system evaluation and error analysis
teaching_simplification: one shared verb paradigm cell is retained; suffix and stem measurements are deterministic orthographic derivations, not source morpheme annotations
